title: aspidium aculeatum subsp. lobatum
intro: Aspidium aculeatum subsp. lobatum, commonly known as the Lopholeum or Lopholeum lobatum, is a subspecies of the fern plant belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. It is a medicinal plant used for its various health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Lopholeum lobatum are attributed to its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been used in traditional medicine for centuries.
